environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a VPC with public subnet and NAT gateway. The task has an IAM role with ec2:DescribeInstances and s3:GetObject permissions. The container runs with default networking - outbound internet access via NAT, and can reach the EC2 instance metadata service at 169.254.169.254. Kafka topic is writable by multiple producer services including an external partner integration that accepts webhook payloads.

config.network: Public subnet with NAT gateway, no egress filtering
config.imds: IMDSv1 enabled (no hop limit enforcement on Fargate)
config.kafka_acl: Producer ACL includes external partner service
config.iam_role: arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/event-processor-role with S3 and EC2 read access
